hook.name: TrinityHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% total fee on every swap (1.5% from each side) by minting ERC-6909 claims in beforeSwap and afterSwap. Fees are periodically settled to three immutable destinations: ~1% burns TRI tokens, ~1% sends ETH to a rewards contract, and ~1% adds liquidity via an engine contract. Only operates on native ETH / TRI pools.
